name: Breakcold
description: Control your Breakcold CRM directly from Claude. Search, update and manage contacts, deals, tasks, notes. Move opportunities through your pipeline, and act on the multichannel conversations synced into your CRM. Claude also removes manual data entry by automating the work for you: advancing deals through the pipeline, creating follow-up tasks from stalled conversations, researching prospects and logging findings, detecting and adding new contacts from your inbox, generating reports tailored to how you work, and even setting up your CRM from a website URL.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Breakcold to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Breakcold to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.breakcold.com/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Breakcold MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Breakcold lists 62 MCP tools, including capabilities_list, crm_field_options_create, crm_field_options_delete, crm_field_options_list, crm_field_options_reorder, crm_field_options_update, crm_fields_create, crm_fields_delete, crm_fields_get, crm_fields_list, crm_fields_reorder, and crm_fields_update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Breakcold?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Breakcold in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Breakcold requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Breakcold is developed by Breakcold. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
